Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread a Bing Copilot blurb that conflated Avicenna with Ismaili doctrinarians and jumped to the conclusion that he was Ismaili without verification. Reliable sources generally identify Avicenna as a Sunni (often Hanafi), and at minimum note that his denomination is debated. The error was concluding “Ismaili” from an unvetted snippet rather than checking authoritative references.
